title: Arguments precede their vertex
statement: Let $C$ be a finite directed acyclic Boolean circuit with $n$ input vertices and a list of gates in topological order. If $v$ is not an input vertex and $v<n+	ext{number of gates}$, then every argument of the gate at position $v-n$ has index strictly less than $v$.
hypotheses_covered: $v$ is not less than the number $n$ of input vertices
$v$ is less than $n$ plus the number of gates
